question.text: Post-issue, the RTA prepares several registers and statements. Which of the following is NOT part of the RTA's post-issue documentation responsibilities?

answer.text: Preparing the distribution schedule and allotment register
Maintaining the register of members and index of members
Filing the return of allotment with the Registrar of Companies
Drafting the underwriting agreement between the issuer and the lead managers

explanation.text: The Logic: The RTA's post-issue documentation, listed on page 112, includes the distribution schedule, Top 50/100 registers, allotment register, register of members, index of members, RoC return of allotment, cross-reference register, and postal journal. The underwriting agreement, however, is a pre-issue agreement item described on pages 109-110, executed before the issue opens, and is not one of the post-issue registers or statements that the RTA prepares. The Trap: The RTA's post-issue documentation list is long, making it easy to slip in a pre-issue item. The underwriting agreement belongs to the pre-issue stage and therefore does not fit under post-issue documentation responsibilities. Note: Distinguish pre-issue agreements and arrangements (pages 109-110) from post-issue registers and statements (page 112) when answering "which is NOT post-issue" questions.
